verses.original: לוּא־ קָרַ֤עְתָּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: lū- qā·ra‘·tā šā·ma·yim yā·raḏ·tā hā·rîm nā·zōl·lū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: If only You would rend the heavens and come down so that mountains would quake at Your presence

verses.original: אֵ֣שׁ כִּקְדֹ֧חַ הֲמָסִ֗ים אֵ֔שׁ מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה־ שִׁמְךָ֖ לְהוֹדִ֥יעַ לְצָרֶ֑יךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ׃ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ’êš kiq·ḏō·aḥ hă·mā·sîm ’êš ma·yim tiḇ·‘eh- šim·ḵā lə·hō·w·ḏî·a‘ lə·ṣā·re·ḵā gō·w·yim yir·gā·zū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: as fire kindles the brushwood [and] causes the water to boil to make Your name known to Your enemies so that the nations will tremble at Your presence

verses.original: בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ׃ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·śō·wṯ·ḵā nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ lō nə·qaw·weh yā·raḏ·tā hā·rîm nā·zōl·lū mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: When You did awesome works that we did not expect You came down and the mountains trembled at Your presence

verses.original: וּמֵעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ לֹֽא־ עַ֣יִן רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘ō·w·lām lō- šā·mə·‘ū lō he·’ĕ·zî·nū lō- ‘a·yin rā·’ā·ṯāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯə·ḵā ya·‘ă·śeh lim·ḥak·kêh- lōw
verses.literal: From ancient times no one has heard no ear has perceived no eye has seen any God besides You who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him

verses.original: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת־ שָׂשׂ֙ וְעֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק יִזְכְּר֑וּךָ בִּדְרָכֶ֖יךָ הֵן־ אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֙פְתָּ֙ וַֽנֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּהֶ֥ם וְנִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃ עוֹלָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: pā·ḡa‘·tā ’eṯ- śāś wə·‘ō·śêh ṣe·ḏeq yiz·kə·rū·ḵā biḏ·rā·ḵe·ḵā hên- ’at·tāh qā·ṣap̄·tā wan·ne·ḥĕ·ṭā bā·hem wə·niw·wā·šê·a‘ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You welcome - those who gladly do right who remember Your ways Surely You were angry for we sinned - How can we be saved if we remain in our sins

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַנְּהִ֤י כַטָּמֵא֙ כָּל־ צִדְקֹתֵ֑ינוּ עִדִּ֖ים וּכְבֶ֥גֶד כֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַנָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽעָלֶה֙ וַעֲוֺנֵ֖נוּ יִשָּׂאֻֽנוּ׃ כָּר֥וּחַ
verses.transliteration: kul·lā·nū wan·nə·hî ḵaṭ·ṭā·mê kāl- ṣiḏ·qō·ṯê·nū ‘id·dîm ū·ḵə·ḇe·ḡeḏ kul·lā·nū wan·nā·ḇel ke·‘ā·leh wa·‘ă·wō·nê·nū yiś·śā·’u·nū kā·rū·aḥ
verses.literal: Each of us has become like something unclean and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags we all wither like a leaf and our iniquities carry us away like the wind

verses.original: וְאֵין־ קוֹרֵ֣א בְשִׁמְךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְהַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וַתְּמוּגֵ֖נוּ בְּיַד־ עֲוֺנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ên- qō·w·rê ḇə·šim·ḵā miṯ·‘ō·w·rêr lə·ha·ḥă·zîq bāḵ kî- his·tar·tā p̄ā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nū wat·tə·mū·ḡê·nū bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·wō·nê·nū
verses.literal: No one calls on Your name [or] strives to take hold of You For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָ֑תָּה אָבִ֣ינוּ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔נוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ׃ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’āt·tāh ’ā·ḇî·nū ’ă·naḥ·nū ha·ḥō·mer wə·’at·tāh yō·ṣə·rê·nū kul·lā·nū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏə·ḵā
verses.literal: But now O LORD You are our Father we are the clay and You are the potter we are all the work of Your hand

verses.original: אַל־ תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהוָה֙ עַד־ מְאֹ֔ד וְאַל־ תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן לָעַ֖ד הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט־ נָ֖א כֻלָּֽנוּ׃ עַמְּךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiq·ṣōp̄ Yah·weh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ wə·’al- tiz·kōr ‘ā·wōn lā·‘aḏ hên hab·beṭ- nā ḵul·lā·nū ‘am·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not be angry O LORD beyond measure do not remember our iniquity forever Oh look upon us we pray we are all Your people

verses.original: קָדְשְׁךָ֖ עָרֵ֥י הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ הָיָ֔תָה מִדְבָּ֣ר יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qāḏ·šə·ḵā ‘ā·rê hā·yū miḏ·bār ṣî·yō·wn hā·yā·ṯāh miḏ·bār yə·rū·šā·lim šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: Your holy cities have become a wilderness Zion has become a wasteland [and] Jerusalem a desolation

verses.original: קָדְשֵׁ֣נוּ וְתִפְאַרְתֵּ֗נוּ בֵּ֧ית אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ הִֽלְל֙וּךָ֙ הָיָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְכָל־ מַחֲמַדֵּ֖ינוּ הָיָ֥ה לְחָרְבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qā·ḏə·šê·nū wə·ṯip̄·’ar·tê·nū bêṯ ’ă·šer ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū hil·lū·ḵā hā·yāh liś·rê·p̄aṯ ’êš wə·ḵāl ma·ḥă·mad·dê·nū hā·yāh lə·ḥā·rə·bāh
verses.literal: Our holy and beautiful temple where our fathers praised You has been burned with fire and all that was dear to us lies in ruins

verses.original: הַעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה יְהוָ֑ה תִתְאַפַּ֖ק תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה וּתְעַנֵּ֖נוּ עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al- ’êl·leh Yah·weh ṯiṯ·’ap·paq te·ḥĕ·šeh ū·ṯə·‘an·nê·nū ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: After all this O LORD will You restrain Yourself Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure
